scientific_limitations: Only the 2-independence complex of a complete bipartite graph with a deleted matching is classified.
No claim is made about persistence maps between different matching sizes, higher independence parameters, or equivariant homotopy.
The undeleted complete-bipartite case and the six-cycle subcase have prior coverage; a complete novelty review cannot exclude unindexed equivalent theorems.
Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Homotopy of second independence complexes after deleting a bipartite matching
